None of the three final answers is correct. The expression can be computed directly:

(s+m+t)(s+m−t)(s−m+t)(s−m−t) = [s² − (m+t)²][s² − (m−t)²] = 2(s⁴+m⁴+t⁴) − (s²+m²+t²)².

This gives 2·25 − 8² = 50 − 64 = −14.

The three solutions' final answers are 875, 39 and 12. Solution 2 reaches the correct simplification and correctly finds s²m²+s²t²+m²t² = 39/2. It then fails to finish and ends with 39, which is not the value of the expression. Solutions 1 and 3 never reach the simplification and give numbers with no support (875 and 12).

Since none is right, I pick Solution 2 only because its derivation is the closest to the correct result.

CHOICE: 2
